text:
The `ai2-and-ai-folders` proposal passes clarity. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags. The brief is short, with three numbered asks and the owner's quote up front. It links `findings-method.md`, and the title is clear. I rewrote nothing and logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I did not open a page or take a screenshot, since this is a `requirements.md` brief with no `page.js`.

I rewrote part of this task, but `findings.md` is still too long. `text-check` now reports 765 words against a limit of 500. I cut the two longest paragraphs, but the rest of the findings are mostly evidence, and trimming them further would cost the proof. The remaining cut is up to the owner.

- **Missing ask list:** the landing outcome did not list the owner's asks, so I appended a new outcome. It ticks the ai2 contents, why it is still there, and the recommendation with the dead folders. It leaves the full `ai/` map unticked because that script timed out at `screenshots`.
- **Trimmed paragraphs:** I cut the 62-word map-script paragraph and two more in `findings.md`. They explained the "Why is it still there?" step and the unconfirmed `Jsonl.js` import.
- **Screenshots:** none taken, since the task changed no site pages and `layout-check` was skipped at landing.

I logged one `rewrote` line in `flags.jsonl`.
